subject: Discovery recap & scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review with HealthCloud
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Torres <danielle.torres@healthcloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 19:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review with HealthCloud

Hi Danielle —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed path forward so we keep momentum: 

1) What we heard you want to validate
- Private deployment option (VPC) for PHI-sensitive inference workloads
- Network isolation, KMS/HSM integration, and audit logging retention
- Performance targets: 100 qps baseline, <150ms p95 for short prompts

2) Proposed next step
- Technical architecture review (60–90m) with your infra and security teams + our solutions engineers (Aditya) and platform lead (Vivek). Goals: review network/VPC requirements, data flow, proof-of-concept scope, and a checklist for on-prem or cloud VPC deployments.

3) Availability windows (PST) — pick one that works for you and I’ll send a calendar invite:
- Thu Feb 19: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Fri Feb 20: 08:30–10:00

Notes/asks before the call:
- Can you share a sample network diagram and the list of required subnets/firewall egress rules? (We attached a short requirements template to make this quicker.)
- Please confirm whether your Key Management will be AWS KMS or a customer HSM so we can prep the right SME.

Attachment: redwood-private-arch-reqs.pdf (short template)

If those times are tight, flag a preferred window and we’ll adjust. Happy to include any other stakeholders from your side (security, platform, procurement).

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0196
Redwood Inference
From: Danielle Torres <danielle.torres@healthcloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Hale <mike.hale@healthcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 21:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review with HealthCloud

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear recap. We’re aligned on the goals.

We can do Fri Feb 20 08:30–09:30 PT (would prefer 60 minutes) — that works for our infra and security leads. I’m attaching the rough network diagram we discussed and flagged the KMS as AWS KMS for now (we may loop an HSM vendor later).

Mike (cc) will be on the call and he can bring procurement context if needed.

Attachment: healthcloud-discovery-notes.pdf

See you Friday —

Danielle
Director, Platform Engineering
HealthCloud
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Torres <danielle.torres@healthcloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mike Hale <mike.hale@healthcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review with HealthCloud

Thanks — confirmed for Fri Feb 20, 08:30–09:30 PT. I’ve created a calendar hold and will follow up with a calendar invite and dial-in.

Aditya/Vivek — can you both join as our SE and platform lead? High-level prep items below so we’re focused: 
- Review HealthCloud diagram (attached) and call out any immediate blockers for VPC-only deployment.
- Prepare notes on KMS integration patterns (AWS KMS + bring-your-own-key) and any HSM impacts.
- Bring a concise checklist of required firewall rules, NAT/egress, and minimum subnet sizing for a 3-node starter cluster.

I’ll include a short agenda in the invite: 1) goals & scope (10m), 2) network/topology walk (20m), 3) security/KMS & data handling (15m), 4) PoC scope and next steps (15m).

Related links: https://cal.com/soojin/redwood-private-demo (calendar slot), https://drive.redwood.com/s/HC-2026-arch-refs

Attachment: redwood-private-arch-reqs.pdf

—
Soojin
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Torres <danielle.torres@healthcloud.com>, Mike Hale <mike.hale@healthcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Internal prep + final calendar invite sent (HealthCloud technical review)

Aditya / Vivek — final prep before the 08:30 PT call (starting now):

- Danielle sent the network diagram and confirmed AWS KMS. I reviewed the diagram and flagged a couple of questions inline in the Drive doc (link above).
- We should prioritize: 1) NAT vs. egress for model downloads, 2) whether HealthCloud wants us to host model artifacts or pull from their private S3, 3) logging retention window for audit logs (they mentioned 365 days).

I added these to the invite agenda and sent the calendar invite to HealthCloud (they accepted). I also attached the redwood-private-arch-reqs.pdf to the event for their team to reference.

If either of you has follow-ups you want to surface on the call, drop them in the Drive doc or DM me so I can adjust the agenda. Otherwise I’ll hand the architecture walkthrough to Aditya and cover rollout/SLAs.

Thanks —
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
